description: Finite-element phase-field crack propagation from the notch of the layered cell into its first interlayer. Reports whether the crack deflects along the interlayer or penetrates the next layer.

layer_modulus_GPa.source: 10.1016_j.jeurceramsoc.2023.11.009#6: Young’s modulus of alumina 367 GPa – same source as ceramic

layer_thickness_um.source: 10.1016_j.actamat.2023.118704#12: shell thickness 70 µm – gives the ceramic layer thickness

output.criterion: deflects when the simulated crack runs along the first interlayer for more than one layer thickness on a side before it reaches the middle of the next ceramic layer
output.method: phase-field fracture (AT2, jax-pfczm, l = 2 pixels) on a 60 x 241 pixel plane-strain section of the cell under a mode-I K-field. The cohesive length E G / s^2 is 0.0754 um against a pixel of 8.17 um, so the fracture is controlled by energy and the interface strength does not enter
